shippingStatus.none: No delivery method goes to a carrier yet. You buy each label yourself.

off.one: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods go to a carrier. You buy each label yourself.
off.other: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods go to a carrier. You buy each label yourself.

on.one: Labels are bought when a parcel is accepted, for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods.
on.other: Labels are bought when a parcel is accepted, for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods.

shippingStatus.stopBody: Parcels accepted from now on reach the pack bench without a label. Labels already bought stay. Your routing and default parcel are kept.
shippingStatus.title: Shipping
shippingStatus.unknown: Could not check this right now.

autoLead.one: Available for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods. For the others you buy the label at the pack bench.
autoLead.other: Available for {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods. For the others you buy the label at the pack bench.

shippingStep.autoLocked: Give at least one delivery method a carrier and save it first.
shippingStep.cannotList: This connection does not report its delivery methods, so its orders cannot go to a carrier. You buy their labels at the pack bench.

coverage.one: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery method goes to a carrier
coverage.other: {withCarrier} of {n} delivery methods go to a carrier

shippingStep.coverageUnknown: Could not read the routing for this connection right now.
shippingStep.defaultsLead: Used when a delivery method has no default parcel of its own.
shippingStep.defaultsTitle: Default parcel for every delivery method

fromNow.one: From now on a label is bought for each parcel accepted on that delivery method{parcel}. Nothing is bought for an order on hold, unpaid or without an address, and orders already waiting are not changed.
fromNow.other: From now on a label is bought for each parcel accepted on those {n} delivery methods{parcel}. Nothing is bought for an order on hold, unpaid or without an address, and orders already waiting are not changed.

shippingStep.fromNowParcel: , with {parcel} unless the delivery method sets its own
shippingStep.loadFailed: Could not load this connection's delivery methods. Its routing is unchanged.
shippingStep.noBody: At the pack bench or in Orders. Nothing is bought on its own.
shippingStep.noCarrierBody: OpenLinker buys labels on your own carrier account, such as InPost or DPD. When the carrier is connected, you come back to this step.
shippingStep.noSourcesBody: No connection sends orders to OpenLinker yet, so there are no delivery methods to choose a carrier for.
shippingStep.routesLead: The same routing as on each connection's mapping page. A change here is a change there.
shippingStep.saveFailedTitle: Could not save the label settings
shippingStep.unsavedBody: You changed which carrier ships some delivery methods and did not click Save routing. If you go on, those changes are lost.
shippingStep.weightDescription: Per product, used only when a product has no weight. The parcel weight is the sum of its products.
shippingStep.weightRequired: Enter a weight for products that have none.
shippingStep.why: Choose which carrier ships each delivery method. Then OpenLinker can buy the label as soon as a parcel is accepted for packing, so the packer only prints it.
shippingStep.yesBody: One label per parcel, on the carrier account its delivery method goes to.
shippingStep.yesTitle: Yes, buy it when a parcel is accepted
